hero_short_about: I'm a full-stack developer based in Poland with over {#b}7 years{/b} of experience.
hero_about_content: Programming is my passion. I strive to improve my interpersonal, logical and programming skills with each day. While making projects I prioritise performance, responsiveness, code readability and maintainability. My other interests include cooking and bodybuilding.
project_gamebox_desc: A fun website where you can play four popular browser games. Features client-side routing and state-driven reactivity.
project_pocketdex_desc: An online Pokedex for Pokemon Elite Redux. Features advanced search filters, pagination, Popover API and discrete transitions.
project_palette_desc: A dynamic palette generator. Features a custom CSS variable powered algorithm, custom toasts and CSS variable exporting.
project_goodlife_desc: A landing page for a client company. Features fully responsive UI, media & SEO optimization and Google Maps integration.
